name: rushlink
description: Unofficial HeadRush desktop companion for tone discovery, rig editing and live performance.
author: RushLink

scripts.release:check: npm run build && node tools/verify-release.mjs && npm run test:site
scripts.test:tonepilot: vitest run src/domain/tone-analysis.test.ts src/domain/tone-audition-chain.test.ts src/domain/tone-catalogue.test.ts src/services/device-api.test.ts src/stores/app-store-performance.test.ts src/stores/sync-adapter.test.ts src/stores/tone-mapping.test.ts src/stores/tone-service-pagination.test.ts src/stores/tonepilot-workspace.test.ts src/stores/tonepilot-audition.test.ts src/stores/tonepilot-save-audition-rig.test.ts src/pages/tonepilot-workspace-ui.test.tsx src/pages/tonepilot-save-rig-dialog.test.tsx src/components/system/device-file-control.test.tsx
scripts.test:stagehand: vitest run src/domain/live-layout.test.ts src/domain/stage-actions.test.ts src/domain/stage-gestures.test.ts src/domain/stage-midi.test.ts src/domain/headrush-midi.test.ts src/domain/stagehand-catalogue.test.ts src/services/device-api.test.ts src/services/midi-connection.test.tsx src/stores/stagehand.test.ts src/pages/live-play.test.tsx src/pages/live-play-conditional.test.tsx tools/verify-stagehand-device.test.js tools/verify-stagehand-device.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:production: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.production.config.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test:coverage:all && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:ci: npm run build && npm run test:native && npm run test:coverage:all && npm run test:stability:ci && npm run test:e2e
